anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, confidence scores, or opportunities, indicating it may not be functioning as intended.
No active or closed trades, and all trading metrics are at zero, which might be expected if the system is in a testing or maintenance phase, but unusual if in active trading.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system failure.
Review and potentially restart the AI component to ensure it is functioning and generating insights as expected.
Evaluate the current trading strategies and system configuration to ensure they align with operational goals and market conditions.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough analysis of the processes consuming CPU resources and optimize or redistribute workloads.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect trading performance, requiring immediate attention to prevent downtime.

recommendations.action: Restart the AI module and monitor its performance to ensure it resumes normal operation.
